findings.finding: Native session maps allow ambiguous inverse overwrites; negative SetMapping writes before its allocation and aborts the reference process.
findings.disposition: Sparse Rust bijections explicitly reject ambiguity and negative/out-of-range IDs. Valid zero/idempotent/ordering/filtering semantics are qualified. Isolated negative reference outcome is a limitation, not a parity success; decision 0020 and inventory disclose scope.

findings.finding: Mapped lookup caches can hide corruption across NTFS callbacks, as in the earlier ordinal regression.
findings.disposition: Reuse Store::integer verified fixed frames, including Windows physical reads. Corruption test and native matrix remain enabled.

findings.finding: New mapped-read oracle code initially changed the frozen fixture generator identity and blocked M0.
findings.disposition: Restored the original driver byte-for-byte; separate tools/mapped executable reuses pinned source/helpers and is separately hashed. Fresh M0/corpus gates pass with no golden/hash/manifest update.

findings.finding: Partial mapped output errors must not discard secondary cursor cleanup errors or replay rows.
findings.disposition: Explicit end/close preserves primary and secondary errors before map cleanup; sticky-error regression checks one returned row, failed next, preserved cleanup error and no replay.

findings.finding: Replacing the registration spool can fail before consuming its sorter.
findings.disposition: Keep the sorter in an Option, explicitly cancel on early failures and record ownership/stats before parent cleanup. Windows handles close before replacement.

findings.finding: Reported handle peaks fell after index cleanup.
findings.disposition: Capture historical peak before releasing store slots; regression asserts before/after-close equality.

limitations: One immutable sparse bijection per session; no native ambiguous collision/inverse overwrite emulation. Labels retain core exact-byte matching, unlike native case-insensitive registration.

Mapped-order reads explicitly fully prescan/sort even identity or monotone mappings; raw streaming API unchanged. Output is borrowed fixed rows, not a projected batch API. Positive limits apply after sorting.
Missing mappings fail by default; SkipRecord is explicit and counts skipped rows. General native data-error streams remain task 027.
Shared root and existing scratch halves; at least seven available handles with one retained map, extra retained stores consume additional slots. Writer registration retains task-025 occurrence bound.
No M4 OS/RSS/throughput acceptance claim. M3 smoke is a regression check rather than a repeated oversized scale run.
Fixed control allocations retain existing infallible std/path allocator limitations. Raw IDs, v7 wire format, dependencies, frozen fixture generator and golden expectations are unchanged.
Caller-to-original raw lookup implemented; direct mapped-to-label convenience, incremental map mutation/auto-expansion and further UEL operations remain task 029.
